Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy postmenopausal women with a uterus.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's menopausal status is not explicitly stated, nor is there information on the presence of a uterus.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Histological diagnosis by a local pathologist of an endometrial biopsy (with the Pipelle suction curette) taken before treatment, as proliferative, secretory or menstrual type endometrium, endometrial metaplasia, endometrial or endocervical polyp(s), endometrial hyperplasia, cancer or any other histological abnormality (leiomyoma(ta), stromal nodules or mesenchymal or (endo)cervical neoplasia(s)).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's endometrial biopsy results.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Double-layer endometrium thickness > 4 mm as assessed by transvaginal ultrasound, immediately before endometrial biopsy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's endometrial thickness.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History or presence of any malignancy, except successfully treated non-melanoma skin cancers.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has metastatic hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer, which is an active malignancy.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Any unexpected vaginal bleeding following the menopause.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's vaginal bleeding status.
The patient has liver lesions due to metastatic breast cancer, but there is no mention of liver disease unrelated to cancer.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Abnormal cervical Pap smear test result, or abnormal mammography result obtained within one year prior to the start of the trial.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's cervical Pap smear or mammography results.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Deep vein thrombosis, thrombophlebitis, thromboembolic disease, or suspicions of having hereditary predisposition for developing venous thromboembolic disease.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's history of thromboembolic disease or predisposition.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Use of one or more of the following drugs within the last two months: hepatic microsomal enzyme-inducing anticonvulsant drugs known to affect or interfere with the pharmacokinetics of steroids (e.g. hydantoins, barbiturates such as Phenobarbital (alone or in combinations, such as Bellergal) rifampicin, griseofulvin, primidone or carbamazepine).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is currently receiving fulvestrant and palbociclib, which are not listed as hepatic microsomal enzyme-inducing anticonvulsants.

Recap: The patient is ineligible for the clinical trial due to the presence of an active malignancy, which violates the exclusion criteria. Other criteria are either irrelevant or not violated based on the provided information.
